messages:
Jordan Lee: morning handoff from night crew — heads up on a hosted API latency incident that we briefly paged on overnight :rotating_light:
Jordan Lee: summary in one line — tokenizer-service experienced a memory growth pattern leading to evictions and p95/p99 spike on text-gen requests in region-usw between 2026-03-15T22:38Z and 2026-03-15T23:05Z. Error rate small (~0.4%) but tail latency hit a few large customers. No persisted data loss.
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: tokenizer-memory-growth-175665 at 2026-03-15T22:40:12Z severity: Sev2 pages: @oncall
SREbot: automated mitigation: scaled tokenizer-service deployment to 6 replicas and set temporary memory limit patch at 2026-03-15T22:45:03Z
Priya Singh: I caught the alert at ~22:40UTC and confirmed increasing container RSS in the tokenizer pods on two nodes. Heap kept climbing until the kubelet OOM killed the pod, which caused short bursts of retries and queueing upstream.
Carlos Mendez: looks consistent with a leaked tokenizer cache introduced in the last runtime bump (v1.2.7). No rollout happened at the same moment though, so it likely accumulated under higher-than-normal request patterns.
Jordan Lee: immediate mitigations we applied last night:
- scaled tokenizer-service to 6 replicas
- rolled the two affected pods to clear RSS
- applied a temporary container memory cap of 1.5Gi and enabled the experimental GC flag to force more frequent cleanup
Commands used (recovery):
```bash
kubectl -n production set resources deployment/tokenizer-service --limits=memory=1500Mi
kubectl -n production rollout restart deployment/tokenizer-service
```
Priya Singh: after the restart and scale, p95 returned to baseline by ~22:58UTC and error rates subsided. We left the memory cap and extra replicas in place for now.
incident-bot: ALERT CLEARED: tokenizer-memory-growth-175665 at 2026-03-15T22:58:47Z
Jordan Lee: customer impact notes — two customers (org-omega, org-saturn) reported slower completions and a retry spike. CS opened tickets and we prepped a short status note; no customers asked for credits.
Carlos Mendez: follow-ups and next actions for day crew:
1) Reproduce locally: add a load test that mimics the high-concurrency path that exercised the tokenizer cache and validate GC flags.
2) Postmortem: small blameless postmortem to capture timeline + why memory growth wasn't surfaced earlier.
3) Instrumentation: add a tokenizer RSS alarm (node-level) and a perf counter for tokenizer cache size.
4) Tune HPA to consider RSS percentiles rather than instantaneous CPU/RPS only.
Jordan Lee: runbook pointers: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tokenizer-memory-leak (primary runbook), https://internal.redwood/runbooks/service-oom (fallback). Please link the new alert rule to the runbook when added.
Priya Singh: schedule/coverage note — I'm primary now for the next 3h while Jordan steps into planning. Carlos is backup until 16:00 UTC. oncall-rotation-bot: @Priya Singh primary for 3h, @Carlos Mendez secondary until 16:00 UTC.
Jordan Lee: outstanding checklist for handoff:
- Keep memory cap for 24h and observe for any regression.
- Carlos to implement local reproduction test and share artifacts in the incident issue.
- Priya to create the tokenizer RSS alert and link to runbook (ETA 2h).
- Engineering to prepare a runtime patch to remove the leaking cache in v1.2.8 (assign to Carlos).
Priya Singh: adding the alert to infra backlog now, will include sample alert thresholds and escalation path.
Carlos Mendez: I'll start the repro today and open a PR for the runtime fix. ETA for PR ~ end of day.
Jordan Lee: additional ops notes — avoid rolling restarts on tensor nodes during high traffic windows; we scheduled the restart at 23:00UTC which was low-traffic for region-usw.
Priya Singh: coverage gaps — we have a planned maintenance on eu-west edge at 17:00 UTC that reduces spare capacity; if tokenizer leaks recur and cross-region routing is triggered, we may need to escalate to cross-region failover. Ping me if that happens.
Jordan Lee: handoff status: mitigated, stable, follow-ups created. Passing to day crew — pls ack once you've copied follow-ups into the incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
Carlos Mendez: acked and started issue skeleton.
Priya Singh: acked. I'll post progress updates in this thread and tag runbook owners when alert rule is live.
SREbot: handoff recorded by Jordan Lee at 2026-03-16T07:10:00Z
Jordan Lee: thanks team, handing off. Coffee for everyone. :coffee:
